title: The view does not require self-directed introspection

statements.text: A perception is conscious only if there is a higher-order representation that one has it, but that representation is itself rarely conscious. Ordinary conscious awareness is not attentive introspection, so the view does not need the medial frontal regions tied to self-directed reflection.

sources.quote: Our view does not imply that conscious perception requires consciously self-directed introspection
Ordinary conscious awareness is not attentively focused introspection
